perturbed_task_language: Put the bowl on the plate
perturbation_semantics: Objects and fixtures are visually relocated; the target bowl and red-ring plate were localized from agentview_high/wrist_high and back_project, not from object coordinates.
expected_baseline_behavior: Pi0 may use memorized base-scene target/place habits; the hybrid localizes the visible bowl and the relocated plate surface before grasping and placing.

bowl.agentview_evidence: patterned black/white bowl with yellow rim, lower-right of stove and right of the wine bottle in agentview_high

plate.agentview_evidence: white ceramic plate with red concentric rings near the cabinet, not the gray stove burner

strategy_notes: Step 1 moved open over the visually identified bowl at [-0.05, 0.16, 1.12] and accepted wrist refinement near [-0.039, 0.149]. Step 2 ran pi0_pick('pick up the bowl', max_chunks=20, lift_thresh=0.05, gripper_closed_thresh=0.06); the bowl was visibly held. Step 3 locked the gripper for 8 steps. Step 4 carried slowly to [-0.09, 0.07, 1.12]. Step 5 carried to the plate-offset target [-0.16, 0.009, 1.11]. Step 6 descended to [-0.16, 0.009, 1.02] while holding gripper:+1. Step 7 released for 30 steps; the bowl was partly on the plate but termination was false. Step 8 made a short low closed-gripper centering nudge to [-0.172, -0.02, 1.03]. Step 9 released for 40 steps; the bowl was more centered but still false. Step 10 used a short local pi0_pick('pick up the bowl', max_chunks=12, lift_thresh=0.04) from the low on-plate pose; this acted as a local settle/regrasp and immediately produced terminated:true.

initial_bowl_pi0_pick_step2.visual_judgment: target bowl visibly raised and held in wrist/agentview

low_local_settle_pi0_pick_step10.visual_judgment: started from bowl already on plate; local Pi0 contact/regrasp seated the bowl enough for predicate
